creditGuide.title: How AI credits work
creditGuide.subtitle: Credits power the AI features. Lessons, vocabulary and exam questions stay free.

step1.title: Credits power AI, not static learning
step1.body: Use %icon% only when you want AI feedback. Reading, listening, vocabulary and exam answers never spend a credit.

step2.title: Voice session · {credits} credit cost
step2.body: Start a %icon%; it uses {credits} credit and one voice slot. Refreshing or retrying the same start does not charge again.
step2.footer: One voice slot per started session.

step3.title: Exam AI · review {review} · plan {plan} credit cost
step3.body: An %icon% has a {review} credit cost; a study plan has a {plan} credit cost. Reopening a generated result is always free.

step4.title: Resets, not rollover
step4.body: Your balance and reset date are shown on this page. Trial credits are a one-time total; there are no top-ups.
step4.footer: Trial credits do not roll over.
